# timer :: 
import contextlib
import time

@contextlib.contextmanager
def timer(label="block"):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
        print(f"{label}: {dt:.6f}s")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    with timer("demo"):
        s = sum(range(1000))
    print(s)
